name: Waterfall.io
one_liner: Waterfall.io is a B2B data enrichment API that aggregates 30+ vendors to provide verified emails, phone numbers, and company data.
access_notes: Pay only for what you use. No monthly commitments or short-term credit expiration - scale up or down whenever you need.

extras.rate_limits: The Prospector, Search, Enrichment, Job Change and Verify Email APIs allow a maximum of 50 requests per minute (60 seconds).
